name: Dice Roller
description: Roll any number of dice with any number of sides (d4 through d100), with a running total and session statistics — using cryptographically secure randomness.

faq.question: Are the rolls actually fair?
faq.answer: Yes — each die uses crypto.getRandomValues() with rejection sampling, the same secure-randomness approach as every generator on this site, so every side has a genuinely equal chance rather than relying on Math.random(), which offers no such guarantee.

faq.question: What do the session stats track?
faq.answer: Every individual die result rolled since your last reset (not just the most recent roll) — the count, minimum, maximum, and running average across all of them, useful for spot-checking that a die "feels" fair over many rolls.
